title: Gov. Pritzker: AI is dangerous ‘on the level of nuclear weapons’
key_facts: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker, in an exclusive interview on ABC's "This Week" that aired on Sunday, urged Congress to pass federal AI guardrails.
Pritzker said "You can't do this state by state" and that AI regulation needs to be a national and international effort with allies.
He called the technology "dangerous on the level of nuclear weapons".
He pointed to the Illinois law he signed in July that requires AI companies to carry out annual third-party audits of their safety plans and to disclose safety incidents to the state.

He said letting AI leaders self-regulate is "a mistake" because there have been "breakouts that they don't control", and that President Trump, who has called AI fears a "hoax" and announced an "AI Force", is taking the wrong approach.

Pritzker said "We don't need to shut it down entirely" but must make sure it does not get out of control; he does not support Senator Bernie Sanders' proposal to ban superintelligence because he thinks it would not be possible.
The interview also covered the November midterm elections, which are less than seven weeks away, and Pritzker's possible 2028 presidential run, which he did not rule out.
